name: Session handoff
description: Continues an agent's work in a fresh session: composes a brief from the old one, lets the person edit it, and starts the new session with it.

method.description: Everything the dialog needs to open on a source: where it can go, the available agents, the controls seeded from the source's draft and the remembered choices, and the templates. Refuses a source with no session context (reason no-context).

agent.description: The agent that ran the session.

providerSessionId.description: The agent CLI's own session id.

worktree.description: A worktree selector the session ran in.

cwd.description: The folder the session ran in.

archived.description: An archived session described by its agent, provider session id and transcript path.

source.description: The session to continue from: a live session id, or an archived one; pass exactly one.

key.description: The key drafts are kept under.

session.description: The live session id, or null for an archived source.

cwd.description: The folder the source ran in, or null.

transcriptPath.description: The transcript path the source reported, or null.

prompt.description: The last user prompt, or null.

lastMessage.description: The last assistant message, or null.

live.description: The source still has a running terminal.

canCreateWorktree.description: The source is in a git repository, so a worktree can be created.

worktree.description: An existing worktree id from the candidates.

base.description: Ref to cut it from; blank means the source worktree's branch.

target.description: Where the new session starts: an existing worktree, or a worktree created at Start. Defaults to the source's worktree.

relationship.description: How the new session relates to the source; recorded, acting on nothing.

context.description: Focused carries status hints; full asks for the whole transcript and needs a usable one.

draft.description: A draft: {controls, preview} where preview is null while attached or {text, stale} once edited. Null when none is kept.

method.description: Composes the brief for a source and controls with its warnings, secret hits and cost. With body, analyzes that edited text instead of composing. Refuses a source with no context (reason no-context) and a target that does not resolve (reason invalid-target).
